Then the Devil taketh Him

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘Then the devil taketh him up.’—M
ATT.
 
IV.
 5, 8
.
W
ILL
 He—O burden worthier angels’ wings!—
Deign to be carried by swift fiend of hell?
Vilest! to thee this no advancement brings;
He no less God, thou no less demon fell.
